summary.text: Cornelius Fowler is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 77, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Tiffany Esposito.
Fowler also ran for the seat in 2024, receiving 33.8 percent of the vote, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as activist.

paragraphs.text: Cornelius Fowler was born in Pahokee, Florida, and graduated from Glades Central Community High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Florida farmworker and truck driver born and raised on the banks of the Everglades, who also attended Palm Beach State College.

In that survey he said he is vice president of Local Lodge 2152 of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers, vice president of the machinists' state council, and a trustee of the Palm Beach Treasure Coast AFL-CIO.
Fowler lost the 2024 general election for District 77 to Esposito, who received 63.9 percent of the vote to his 33.8 percent; Libertarian Joshua Krakow received 2.2 percent.
Ballotpedia lists the Florida Education Association and the Florida AFL-CIO among his 2026 endorsements.
